title: chromamancer scheme v1
description: Portable color + font + asset scheme (JSONC on disk). v1: Base16 tokens, global font families, optional assets, optional target_overrides. Default Base16→target mapping lives in chromamancer adapters, not in this file.

name.description: Display id for this scheme pack (often matches directory name under schemes/).

version.description: Scheme pack revision (authoring), not the schema revision.

tokens.description: Canonical Base16 palette. Keys are base00..base0F; values #RRGGBBAA. Generators map these to terminals, QPalette/Kvantum, GTK, Hyprland, etc.

fonts.description: Global font *family* names only. Sizes and weights belong in Home Manager, target configs, or user preferences—not in the scheme.

assets.description: Paths relative to scheme directory root unless noted otherwise.

target_overrides.description: Optional per-target blobs merged over chromamancer’s built-in adapter output. Keys are target ids (e.g. hyprland, kitty). Shapes are adapter-defined; omit when defaults from Base16/fonts/assets suffice.

RgbaHex.description: RGB + alpha, eight hex digits after #. Opaque colors use FF (e.g. #1a1b26FF).

family.description: Font family as consumed on Linux (e.g. Fontconfig family name). Targets may normalize.
